metadataRaw.title: Best Standing Sciatica Exercises | Relief in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates the best exercises to quickly relieve sciatica pain while standing.

These exercises can be done at home and may provide instant relief—sometimes in as little as 30 seconds!

The focus is on relieving tension and pressure on the sciatic nerve, offering fast relief from sharp leg pain when standing. This includes sciatica caused by a lumbar spinal disc bulge, herniation, or piriformis syndrome.

Additionally, these stretches can help prevent sciatica pain during prolonged standing. If you're often on your feet for long periods and experience leg pain, you won’t want to miss this!

Watch now for quick sciatica relief!

0:00 Intro
0:54 Wall Bridge and Lean
3:51 Extension
5:59 Step Back (Piriformis and Glutes)
